title: The Secret Camera Angles That Make AI Images Look Professional
description: Cinematic camera angles like fisheye or Dutch angle make AI images look more dynamic and professional than flat perspectives.
transcript: Most AI designs still look normal. The reason usually isn't the AI, it's the camera angle. The best designers aren't generating images from normal perspectives anymore. They're using cinematic angles to make visuals feel more premium and high-end. One of the easiest tricks, add fisheye distortion to your prompt. Suddenly the image feels dynamic, stylized, and much more professional. And that's just one angle. [music] You can also use Dutch angle, extreme close-up, overhead shots, and POV framing. These small prompt changes completely [music] transform how your AI images look. I've collected a full list of advanced camera angles, visual references, and detailed prompts you can use for your own designs. Comment [music] "design" and I'll send everything to you.
